_comment: Tosa Rail station-map network. Source of truth for export_station_map.py. Coordinates are canvas pixels; every node and waypoint must sit on a cell centre (8k+4) and every run must be 0/45/90 degrees. label = [anchor, dx, dy]: anchor c = centred on the node, l = text ends left of the node, r = text starts right of the node; dy is from the node centre to the label's text cell (small font). bgPalette: the BG palette slot of the line's tube colour (0 orchid/purple, 1 sea/teal, 2 forest/green).
